Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 5 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 12:37 PM ET

Trevor Lawrence has the highest SPAGS projection in the Jaguars at Ravens DraftKings Showdown: 18.2 points at $10,600 FLEX, 27.3 at captain for $15,900. Across 10,000 simulations Lawrence holds 80% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Lawrence is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.3 points at a $10,600 FLEX salary, in a game with a 41.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 19.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Lawrence at captain. Bhayshul Tuten is the next captain in line, at 17.7%. The model gives him 16.1 carries and 2.2 targets.

Jacksonville is a 9.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 25.5 for the Jaguars and 16 for the Ravens. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Lawrence and Tuten, the next projections are Parker Washington (13.7, $9,400), Derrick Henry (13.3, $10,200) and Joe Fagnano (13.3, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 12:37 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Trevor Lawrence, JAX QB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Trevor Lawrence holds 19.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 18.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Lawrence averaged 18.4 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 36.2. He holds 80% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 19.4% as the captain and 60.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Bhayshul Tuten, JAX RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Bhayshul Tuten holds 17.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 15.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 16.1 carries and 2.2 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Tuten averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 34.6. He holds 62% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.7% as the captain and 44.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Parker Washington, JAX WR ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Parker Washington holds 13.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 13.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 20.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 5.8 targets on 21.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Washington averaged 13.6 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 39.1. He holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.6% as the captain and 28.5% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Jaguars vs Ravens

Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Derrick Henry carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.3 DraftKings points for a $10,200 FLEX salary ($15,300 at captain). The model gives him 17.4 carries and 1.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Henry averaged 13.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 31.9. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.4% as the captain and 33.3% in a FLEX spot.

Joe Fagnano, BAL QB ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

Joe Fagnano carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.3 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model includes 3.3 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Fagnano averaged 13.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.2 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.0% as the captain and 49.3% in a FLEX spot.

Brenton Strange, JAX TE ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Brenton Strange carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.3 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 4.6 targets on 18.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Strange averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.2 and a ceiling of 25.4. He holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.0% as the captain and 28.5% in a FLEX spot.

Zay Flowers, BAL WR ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Zay Flowers carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.6 DraftKings points for a $10,400 FLEX salary ($15,600 at captain). The model gives him 5.6 targets on 18.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Flowers averaged 9.6 points with a simulated floor of 2.0 and a ceiling of 24.8. He holds 23% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.2% as the captain and 19.9% in a FLEX spot.

Chris Rodriguez Jr. projects for 6.8 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.99 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 7.2 carries and 0.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Rodriguez averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 13.8. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.6% as the captain and 19.5% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Justice Hill, BAL RB ($3,200 FLEX / $4,800 CPT)

Justice Hill projects for 6.3 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 1.97 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.6 carries and 3.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hill averaged 6.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 14.5. He holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.7% as the captain and 12.4% in a FLEX spot.

Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Trevor Lawrence holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 19.4%, ahead of Bhayshul Tuten (17.7%) and Parker Washington (13.6%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Jaguars vs Ravens?

Build around Derrick Henry at captain with Trevor Lawrence, Joe Fagnano and Brenton Strange at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (23 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,300 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Trevor Lawrence leads the SPAGS model at 18.2 DraftKings points for $10,600 at FLEX, or 27.3 points at captain for $15,900.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Jaguars vs Ravens Showdown?

Trevor Lawrence is the most expensive player at $10,600 FLEX and $15,900 at captain. All 34 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Chris Rodriguez Jr. (6.8 points at $3,400), Justice Hill (6.3 points at $3,200) and Ravens (4.5 points at $3,000).

What is the Jaguars vs Ravens spread and total?

The Jaguars are a 9.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 41.5, with implied team totals of 25.5 for the Jaguars and 16 for the Ravens.
